name: Malibu Watersports
summary: A watersports operator on Mullins Beach on the west coast, teaching water skiing to children and adults and running wakeboarding, kneeboarding and towed rides. Coastal cruises can stop to snorkel with turtles and over a shallow wreck, and a water taxi runs guests to restaurants and hotels. An inflatable trampoline and iceberg float off the beach during school holidays.
standouts: Over 20 years of watersports on the west coast
Water ski teaching for children and adults
Inflatable trampoline and iceberg off Mullins Beach in school holidays
